result.instructions: Tools for Anvil, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Anvil data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run anvil_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run anvil_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run anvil_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. anvil_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: anvil_current_user
tools.title: Current Anvil user
tools.description: Get the authenticated Anvil user (from the API key) and the organizations they belong to (eid, name, slug). Good first call to discover org slugs/eids for other tools. GraphQL query: currentUser.

tools.name: anvil_get_organization
tools.title: Get organization
tools.description: Fetch an Anvil organization and its PDF templates (casts) and workflows (welds). Provide either its slug or its eid (at least one is required). GraphQL query: organization.

slug.description: Organization slug (from anvil_current_user). Provide this OR eid.

eid.description: Organization eid. Provide this OR slug.

tools.name: anvil_get_cast
tools.title: Get cast (PDF template)
tools.description: Fetch a cast — an Anvil PDF template — by its eid: title, version number, and whether it is a template. Use the returned eid as the cast_eid for anvil_fill_pdf. GraphQL query: cast.

tools.name: anvil_get_etch_packet
tools.title: Get Etch e-signature packet
tools.description: Fetch an Etch e-signature packet by eid: its status, details URL, document group, and every signer (eid, aliasId, name, email, status, routing order). Use this to check signature progress. GraphQL query: etchPacket.

eid.description: The Etch packet eid (returned by anvil_create_etch_packet).

tools.name: anvil_get_weld
tools.title: Get weld (workflow)
tools.description: Fetch a weld — an Anvil workflow — by eid, including its forges (the individual form steps: eid, name, slug). GraphQL query: weld.

tools.name: anvil_get_weld_data
tools.title: Get weld data (workflow submission)
tools.description: Fetch a weldData record — a single submission to a weld (workflow) — by eid: completion state, test flag, and creation time. GraphQL query: weldData.

tools.name: anvil_fill_pdf
tools.title: Fill a PDF template
tools.description: Fill an Anvil PDF template (cast) with data and return the finished PDF as base64. REST: POST /fill/{castEid}.pdf. Returns { filename, byteLength, pdfBase64 }. The `data` object's keys are the template's field aliases.

cast_eid.description: The cast (PDF template) eid to fill (from anvil_get_cast).

data.description: Object mapping the template's field aliases to values, e.g. { "name": "Sam", "date": "2026-07-16" }.

title.description: Optional title embedded in the generated PDF metadata.

fontSize.description: Optional default font size for filled text.

textColor.description: Optional default text color as a hex string, e.g. #333333.

tools.name: anvil_generate_pdf
tools.title: Generate a PDF from HTML or Markdown
tools.description: Generate a brand-new PDF from HTML or Markdown and return it as base64. REST: POST /generate-pdf. For type=html, pass data = { html, css? }. For type=markdown, pass data = [ { label, content }, ... ]. Returns { filename, byteLength, pdfBase64 }.

data.description:
For html: { html: "

Hi

", css?: "..." }. For markdown: [ { label: "Section", content: "# Title\n..." }, ... ].

title.description: Optional title embedded in the generated PDF metadata.

annotations.title: Generate a PDF from HTML or Markdown

tools.name: anvil_create_etch_packet
tools.title: Create Etch e-signature packet
tools.description: Create an Etch e-signature packet (documents + signers). GraphQL mutation: createEtchPacket. IMPORTANT: isDraft defaults to true (a safe draft that sends nothing). Setting isDraft=false with real signers SENDS signature-request emails to those signers. Use isTest=true while developing.

signers.description: Array of signer objects, e.g. [{ id, name, email, signerType, routingOrder, fields }]. Passed straight through to Anvil.

files.description: Array of file/document objects (casts or uploads) to include. Passed straight through to Anvil.

data.description: Optional payload data used to pre-fill the packet's documents.

isDraft.description: Default true. When true, creates a draft and sends nothing. Set false to activate and email signers.

isTest.description: Set true to create a test packet (no legal weight, no charge).

signatureEmailSubject.description: Optional subject line for the signature-request email.

signatureEmailBody.description: Optional body text for the signature-request email.

tools.name: anvil_generate_etch_sign_url
tools.title: Generate Etch signing URL
tools.description: Generate a one-time embedded signing URL for a specific signer in an Etch packet (for iframe/redirect signing flows). GraphQL mutation: generateEtchSignURL. Returns { url }.

signer_eid.description: The signer eid (from the packet's documentGroup.signers).

client_user_id.description: Your app's stable id for the signing user (ties the session to your user).
